text: {"lessons":["My early decision to make no trades did not prevent losses; I should review whether my holdings and risk still fit my plan, rather than treating inaction as automatically safe.","Selling appreciated stocks and buying others changed my portfolio, but the later account movements do not show that the trades improved results; I should make each trade for a clear, forward-looking reason, not to lock in gains or chase a move.","Because prices are unpredictable and I feel losses more strongly than gains, I should use a consistent risk and diversification plan and avoid reacting to short-term account swings."]}
